release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD6537T-25H4LX is an explosion-proof (ATEX / IECEx) thermographic bi-spectrum positioning system pairing a 384x288 thermal module with a 4 MP 40x optical channel, offering temperature measurement (-20 to 550 C) and fire detection in an IP68 / IK10 flameproof housing for hazardous industrial areas. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical is Channel 1 and thermal is Channel 2, exposed as separate streams. PTZ via ONVIF.
